expert_yaml:
skill: door_push
dsl_version: 2
skill_type: arm

phases:
  - id: approach_handle
    type: approach
    generator: arc_cartesian
    control: position_control
    termination: pose_tolerance
    target:
      source: yaml
      anchor: site
      entity: door_handle
      offset: [0.0, 0.06, 0.0]
      tolerance: 0.015
      orientation: {mode: keep_current}
    parameters:
      approach_arc_height:
        type: scalar
        range: [0.03, 0.09]
        default: 0.05
        binds_to:
          - {path: generator.arc_height, mode: replace}

  - id: contact_handle
    type: contact
    generator: linear_cartesian
    control: force_threshold_switch
    termination: contact_detected
    target:
      source: yaml
      anchor: site
      entity: door_handle
      offset: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
      tolerance: 0.01
      orientation: {mode: keep_current}

  - id: push_handle_arc_chord
    type: push
    generator: linear_cartesian
    control: impedance_control
    termination: time_limit
    target:
      source: yaml
      anchor: site
      entity: door_handle
      offset: [0.065, -0.20, 0.0]
      tolerance: 0.025
      orientation: {mode: keep_current}
    parameters:
      push_time:
        type: scalar
        range: [2.0, 4.0]
        default: 3.0
        binds_to:
          - {path: duration.max_time, mode: replace}
    guards:
      - id: door_opened
        when: after_phase
        predicate: hinge_delta_reached
        args: {joint: door_hinge, mode: delta_from_initial}
        threshold: 0.45
        on_failure: retry
    retries:
      max_attempts: 1
      strategy: repeat

  - id: retract_from_door
    type: retract
    generator: linear_cartesian
    control: position_control
    termination: pose_tolerance
    target:
      source: yaml
      anchor: current_tcp
      offset: [0.0, 0.10, 0.10]
      tolerance: 0.02
      orientation: {mode: keep_current}
